notes.title: Siphonophore Puzzle Guide
notes.notes:
Some of the feedback I have been getting has me currently revising the Game's Tutorial Section which occurs in the first area. And as a hold over until the next patch, an in-depth Guide to both Controlling Seraph's Feeding Mechanic and Completing various Level Puzzles is now available on the Siphonophore Discussion Forum.
